title: T-Bone Walker in Houston clubs
summary: Helen Dance asks about T-Bone Walker's Houston dates; Cobb says he played the Harlem Grill and Eldorado, and mentions the Peacock run by Don Robey.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Well, listen -- T-Bone used to play Houston an awful lot of times, didn't he?
And I was wondering what kind of spots he played in Houston.
He played every one we played.

Was there a place called the Peacock?
